title: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing): Patient Class and Final-Bill Schedule
content:
Every Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) belongs to one patient class, fixed by the registration that opened it. The class sets how long charges are held before the final bill drops, whether the account is billed once or month by month, how long a late charge can still be billed, and how long an unanswered insurance claim waits before billing reviews it.

## Schedule terms

- **Bill-hold days**: the calendar days after the service end date (for the Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account, after the last day of each service month) before the final bill drops to the payer or to the patient.
- **Billing frequency**: *per encounter* means one final bill covers the whole encounter; *monthly series* means each calendar month of a recurring series is billed separately.
- **Late-charge window**: the calendar days after the final bill date within which a late charge may still post and be billed; a late charge found after it is written off and never billed to the patient.
- **Insurer no-response days**: the calendar days after the claim's submitted date with no adjudication after which the account is reviewed for patient billing.

## Schedule by patient class

| Patient class | Registered by | Longest service span (days) | Bill-hold days | Billing frequency | Late-charge window (days) | Insurer no-response days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Outpatient Clinic Visit Account | scheduled or walk-in clinic visit | 1 | 3 | per encounter | 7 | 45 |
| Outpatient Diagnostic Imaging & Lab Account | order from a referring provider | 1 | 4 | per encounter | 10 | 45 |
| Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account | therapy plan of care (physical, occupational or speech therapy, infusion or cardiac rehab) | 31 | 5 | monthly series | 30 | 60 |
| Emergency Department Visit Account | emergency department arrival (EMTALA screening) | 2 | 4 | per encounter | 10 | 60 |
| Outpatient Surgery Account | scheduled procedure with surgical case number | 1 | 5 | per encounter | 14 | 60 |
| Observation Stay Account | physician observation order | 3 | 4 | per encounter | 14 | 60 |
| Inpatient Admission Account | physician inpatient admission order | 365 | 5 | per encounter | 30 | 90 |

## Reading the schedule

*Example (hypothetical dates).* An Emergency Department Visit Account whose service ended on a given day has its final bill drop 4 calendar days later; a late charge on that account is billable only if it posts within 10 calendar days after the final bill date.

*Example (hypothetical).* A Recurring Outpatient Therapy Account is not billed once at the end of the plan of care: each calendar month of the series is billed on its own, 5 calendar days after the last day of that service month.
